newsitem.title: USA: AMERCO says Q1 won't meet expectations.
newsitem.headline: AMERCO says Q1 won't meet expectations.

text.p: AMERCO Inc, the holding company for U-Haul International truck rentals, said late Wednesday that its first quarter earnings would not meet analysts' expectations.
The company attributed the shortfall largely to weaknesses in truck rental revenues and increased costs in fleet repairs.
According to First Call, the consensus estimate by analysts is a profit of $1.37 per share. In the prior year's first quarter, the company posted a profit of $1.15 per share.
The company said it plans to release its first quarter earnings on August 19. Its first quarter ended June 30.
